units.source_text: 到了六女公子结婚三朝那一天，明石皇后玉体违和，大家都到宫中问候。

en.t: On the third day after the Sixth Princess's marriage, Empress Akashi was feeling unwell, and everyone went to the palace to inquire after her.

units.source_text: 但皇后是稍感风寒，并无重症，因此夕雾左大臣昼间就退出了。

en.t: But the Empress had only caught a slight cold and was not seriously ill, so Yugiri, the Minister of the Left, withdrew during the day.

units.source_text: 他邀请薰中纳言同车出宫。

en.t: He invited Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, to leave the palace in the same carriage.

units.source_text: 今夜的仪式，左大臣打算办得体面隆重，尽善尽美，然而也有限度。

en.t: For that night's ceremony, the Minister of the Left meant to make everything proper, splendid, and as perfect as possible, though there were limits.

units.source_text: 他招请薰中纳言参与此会，颇觉难以为情，

en.t: He felt rather embarrassed about inviting Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, to take part in the gathering,

units.source_text: 但在诸亲百眷之中，和他血缘最近的，除了薰中纳言之外更无其他相当的人物。

en.t: but among all their many relatives, no one was closer to him by blood, or more suitable, than Kaoru.

units.source_text: 况且薰中纳言在布置仪式等方面，手段特别高明，因此招请了他。

en.t: Moreover, Kaoru was especially skilled at arranging ceremonies and such matters, and for that reason he was invited.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言今天特别起劲，很早就赴六条院。

en.t: Kaoru was particularly eager that day and went to Rokujo-in very early.

units.source_text: 他并不惋惜六女公子被他人所得，只管和左大臣两人同心协力地照料事务。

en.t: He showed no regret that the Sixth Princess had gone to another man, but simply worked together with the Minister of the Left to look after the arrangements.
The Minister of the Left was secretly displeased.

units.source_text: 匂亲王于黄昏过后来到六条院。

en.t: Prince Niou arrived at Rokujo-in after dusk.

units.source_text: 新婿的席位设在正殿南厢的东面。

en.t: The bridegroom's seat was set on the eastern side of the south aisle of the main hall.

units.source_text: 置办筵席八桌，杯盘照例十分讲究。

en.t: Eight banquet tables were prepared, and the cups and dishes were, as usual, exceedingly elegant.

units.source_text: 又有小席二桌，上设雕花脚的盘子，

en.t: There were also two smaller tables, on which stood dishes with carved floral legs,

units.source_text: 式样非常新颖，是盛三朝饼的。

en.t: their design quite novel, meant for holding the third-day wedding cakes.

units.source_text: 记录此种毫不足珍的琐事，笔者自觉乏味。

en.t: In recording such trifles, hardly worth noting at all, the author herself finds it tedious.
